name: @metorial/amplitude
description: Ingest events, query analytics, download raw events and saved chart CSVs, manage cohorts and taxonomy, update user properties, and handle annotations and privacy requests through Amplitude REST APIs. OAuth adds user and project discovery, saved chart reads and queries, feature flags, and tracking-plan search. Experiment configuration and deployments require an optional management API key. Chart authoring, rendering, saving, renaming, experiment statistical analysis, dashboards, notebooks, and monitors are not currently available through this integration's verified REST endpoints.
